Fast Non-Autoregressive Decision Encoders

Modern System 1 classification models achieve sub-millisecond latencies by avoiding autoregressive generation loops.

By leveraging bidirectional self-attention architectures like ModernBERT and mmBERT, these models produce calibrated discrete choices directly.

Key Advantages

  • Deterministic routing with constant-time execution
  • Zero hallucination in decision output heads
  • Low memory footprint suitable for edge and real-time streaming
